title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-09
headline: Isar Aerospace Spectrum rocket reaches orbit from Norway in a European first

questions.prompt: Who developed the Spectrum rocket that reached orbit from Norway?
questions.hintKo: Isar Aerospace is the German company behind Spectrum.

questions.prompt: What can the Spectrum rocket carry once production scales up?
choices: Civilian and military satellites into low-Earth orbit
questions.hintKo: Its payload is satellites, not food or physics samples.

questions.prompt: When did Isar's first rocket fail near the same launch site?
choices: About eighteen months before this successful flight
questions.hintKo: The earlier failure came roughly eighteen months before this orbit success.

questions.prompt: Where did the successful Spectrum launch take place?
choices: Andoya spaceport in Norway, north of the Arctic Circle
questions.hintKo: Andoya in Norway was the launch site, not South Dakota or Sydney.

questions.prompt: Why do European leaders want more launch capacity at home?
choices: To cure osteoarthritis with one injection
To reduce dependence on other nations and strengthen security
questions.hintKo: Europe wants its own capacity for security and economic reasons.

questions.prompt: How much payload can the Spectrum rocket haul?
questions.hintKo: Payload capacity is about one tonne, not energy units or money.
